relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that CP612 blocks paclitaxel-induced hyperalgesia, an effect that is no longer present after 24 hours.

relationships.subject: CP612
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that a single dose of the PKCε inhibitor can prevent hyperalgesia induced by opioid withdrawal.

key_findings: CP612 is a nanomolar ATP-competitive PKCε inhibitor, ~55-fold selective over ROCK1, that blocks paclitaxel hyperalgesia and prevents/reverses opioid-withdrawal hyperalgesia.
CP612 was not self-administered and did not alter morphine self-administration.
